images.c_farhod: CHAR: Young Uzbek programmer Farhod, 26, messy black hair, black t-shirt, hoodie around shoulders, tired red eyes, holding a laptop, grinning stubbornly, half body.
images.c_farhod_hayron: CHAR: Same young man as in the reference image (Farhod, messy black hair, black t-shirt), shocked face, eyes wide, pointing at himself, half body.
images.c_farhod_kulgan: CHAR: Same young man as in the reference image (Farhod, messy black hair, black t-shirt), refreshed happy smile, clear eyes, giving a thumbs up, half body.
images.c_dilorom: CHAR: Uzbek woman ophthalmologist Dilorom, 50, white doctor's coat, stethoscope, reading glasses pulled down to the tip of her nose, kind but strict look, half body.
images.c_nilufar: CHAR: Uzbek young woman Nilufar, 19, ponytail, pastel pajamas, worried face with hands on her cheeks, half body.
images.p_taymer: PROP: a round white kitchen timer, realistic, simple.
images.01: SCENE: Evening home office, young Uzbek programmer (26, messy black hair, black t-shirt) staring at three bright monitors with lines of code, red tired eyes, an empty energy drink can and a cold cup of tea on the desk.
images.02: SCENE: 2 AM, the same young man on a sofa with a laptop on his knees and a phone in his hand at the same time, screen light on his face, blanket, dim lamp.
images.02_b: EDIT 02: Only one small change: his eyes are now very red and one eyelid is twitching, comic exaggeration.
images.03: SCENE: Doorway of the living room, his younger sister (19, ponytail, pastel pajamas) pointing at him in shock, the young man on the sofa with laptop, dim night light.
images.04: SCENE: Bright clean ophthalmologist's office, an eye chart on the wall (abstract shapes, no readable text), a woman doctor of 50 in a white coat lowering her glasses to the tip of her nose looking at the young man sitting in the patient chair.
images.07: SCENE: The young man in the doctor's office looking stunned, the woman doctor holding up a small round kitchen timer, bright clinic light.
images.08: SCENE: Bright day, the young man standing at an open window, looking far away and smiling, on the opposite balcony a fluffy cat sits in the sun among flower pots, city trees.
